_notes.monsters: hp = EASY health = blaster hits (blaster does 1). hp_by_difficulty = EASY / NORMAL / HARD / NIGHTMARE as shipped (neon-caster/tuning-defaults.txt over monsters.txt / GAME/MONTYPES.BI). Damage is EASY's; NIGHTMARE: you take x1.25, and every machine but turrets, mimics, wardens, colossi and ICE comes in twins. Speeds in cells a frame: you walk 0.06, run 0.12. Weak spot hit = x2 damage (x2.5 HARD, x3 NIGHTMARE). type_no is the number summon/spawn/[events] take; summon also takes the name or its start. All woken monsters open doors, and their shots hit other monsters (who may turn on them).
_notes.pickups: name = LootName$ (the [loot] / item / [things] name). Amounts are EASY (as shipped); by_difficulty = EASY / NORMAL / HARD / NIGHTMARE. Weapons: blaster (gun 1, cells, never a pickup), scatter 2, repeater 3, railgun 4, launcher 5.
_notes.puzzles: Code terminals ($). default_sector = which sector's terminals use it when the level file has no 'puzzles =' line (sector number MOD 10). blanks = the words cut out (spoilers).

monsters.name: drone
monsters.attack: melee bite up close (about once a second)
monsters.sight/notes: Flies (hovers, rises and drops to your height). Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: gunner
monsters.attack: plasma bolt (range 11 cells, about every 2 s)
monsters.sight/notes: Keeps 3.5-7 cells away, backs off if you close in. Slaps an alarm switch it passes. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: heavy
monsters.attack: melee smash (reach 1.25, about every 1.6 s)
monsters.sight/notes: Big: a scatter blast lands more pellets. Slaps alarm switches. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: crawler
monsters.attack: melee nip (about once a second)
monsters.sight/notes: Small spider bot, low to the ground; comes in packs. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.
monsters.weak_spot: its red eyes, low at the front

monsters.name: sentry
monsters.attack: plasma bolt (range 11, about every 1.2-1.7 s)
monsters.sight/notes: A gun post: never moves. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: stalker
monsters.attack: melee blade slash (about once a second)
monsters.speed: normal - 0.052 (nearly your walk; run to lose it)
monsters.sight/notes: Cyborg with blades. Slaps alarm switches. A broken specimen tank lets out a stalker or spitter half the time. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: spitter
monsters.attack: spits bolts (range 11, about every 1.6-2 s)
monsters.sight/notes: Mutant; keeps its distance like a gunner (3.5-7 cells). Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.
monsters.unsure: Docs call them acid bolts, but the code fires the same plasma bolt as the gunner (no acid effect).

monsters.name: overseer
monsters.attack: fan of 3 plasma bolts (about every 0.75-1.25 s)
monsters.sight/notes: Boss: a giant floating eye (flies). NEXUS speaks through it when it wakes. Keeps 3.5-7 cells off. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: thief
monsters.attack: steals: half your cells and shells, and the gun in your hands (else your best gun - never the blaster)
monsters.speed: fast - 0.09 (faster than you walk, slower than you run)
monsters.sight/notes: Then runs home to its hoard (event 7) - if it gets in, the hoard is locked for good. Each hit knocks some of your things loose; hit before it steals, it runs home empty-handed. No hoard: just runs from you.

monsters.name: ice
monsters.attack: hunter: bite; sentinel: data bolts; tracer: watches; black ICE: heavy hit
monsters.sight/notes: The network's ICE (after jacking in at a data station @): NOT placeable on a map, and summon/spawn only hunts in the network. Kinds: hunter, sentinel (still, 6 hp), tracer (2 hp, keeps 3-4 cells off and fills the TRACE fast), black ICE (12 hp, slow). Flies.
monsters.unsure: Network-only; sentinel/tracer/black hp are fixed in NetSetup (6/2/12) and ignore difficulty.

monsters.name: sniper
monsters.attack: laser: aims a faint red line that follows you (a little behind) for under a second, then fires a white-hot beam - step out of it
monsters.sight/notes: Keeps 6-12 cells off; fires from up to 18 cells. Slaps alarm switches. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: trooper
monsters.attack: 3-bolt burst (range 13, about every 1.7-2.2 s)
monsters.sight/notes: Keeps 3.5-7 cells away. Slaps alarm switches. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: ripper
monsters.attack: melee slash: lunges in, slashes (claw marks on screen), leaps back out of reach
monsters.sight/notes: Hit and run. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.

monsters.name: warden
monsters.damage: laser 24; ring bolts 5 each; aimed bolts 10 each
monsters.attack: turn about: an aimed laser, then a ring of 10 bolts plus 3 at you
monsters.sight/notes: Field boss. Keeps 5-10 cells off. Not twinned on NIGHTMARE. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.
monsters.drops: an overcharge, armour, and a gun you haven't got (else a big medkit)

monsters.name: colossus
monsters.attack: up close a slam that shakes the floor (reach 1.9); 3-12 cells off a fan of 3 heavy bolts
monsters.sight/notes: Field boss: comes on and on, never backs off. Not twinned on NIGHTMARE. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.
monsters.drops: a damage amp, a big medkit, cells and shells

monsters.name: turret
monsters.damage: plasma 4-5 a bolt (other weapons: see notes)
monsters.attack: ceiling turret: hidden till it sees you, slides down, turns onto you, then 5-bolt bursts (range 13)
monsters.speed: still - 0 (turns 90 degrees a second as made)
monsters.sight/notes: 3D model; can't be hit till fully out (a shot at its hatch wakes it). WEAPON per turret ([monsters] 8th number): plasma, laser 14-19, lightning 10-15 (11 cells), flame / poison / acid sprays (3, 2, 3 a puff; 5-6 cells), missiles (homing, blast 22). A turret control panel (;) hacked switches off every turret within 12 cells. Destroyed it blows up; a ceiling one falls. Not twinned on NIGHTMARE.

monsters.name: floorturret
monsters.attack: rises out of the floor, then as the ceiling turret
monsters.sight/notes: Same as ~, mounted in the floor.

monsters.name: wallturret
monsters.attack: slides out of a wall beside its cell at chest height, then as the ceiling turret
monsters.sight/notes: Can only turn 70 degrees either side of straight out of its wall. With no wall beside it, it's a floor turret. Summoned: in the wall you face, out already.

monsters.name: mimic
monsters.attack: melee bite (about every 0.9 s)
monsters.sight/notes: Looks just like a treasure chest ([) while asleep (lock glows pink, not cyan). Woken only by Space on it, standing within a cell of it, or a shot - not by alarms or barks. Not twinned on NIGHTMARE.

monsters.name: robodog
monsters.attack: melee bite (about every 0.7 s)
monsters.speed: fast - 0.078 (quicker than you walk, slower than you run)
monsters.sight/notes: A thing (" with [things] robodog). When it sees you it barks: every sleeping machine within 10 cells wakes and comes (not turrets or mimics). Keeps barking while it hunts. Asleep till it sees you within 14 cells (or is shot); then hunts you for good.
monsters.summon_names: robodog (things also take dog, robotdog, guarddog)

monsters.name: guard
monsters.attack: plasma pistol bolt (range 11, every 1.4-1.9 s)
monsters.sight/notes: A thing (" with [things] guard). Sees you, then runs for the nearest alarm switch that's on (40 steps at most) and sets the alarm off (every machine within 24 cells wakes); then fights like a gunner (3.5-7 cells off). Shoot the switch first or switch the alarms off.

monsters.name: eyebot
monsters.damage: laser 5-7; blast 34 at its middle (less further off, 2.1 cells across)
monsters.attack: laser zaps, then rushes you and explodes
monsters.sight/notes: A thing (" with [things] eyebot). Flies, rising or dropping to you. Circles 5-8 cells off zapping; after 2 zaps or once you're within 3.5 cells it dives at you beeping faster and blows up (or after 2.5 s). Shot down mid-dive it blows up where it is. Counts for the Bestiary.

pickups.name: red
pickups.what: Red keycard: kept for the rest of the sector, opens every red door (R).

pickups.name: blue
pickups.what: Blue keycard: kept for the rest of the sector, opens every blue door (B).

pickups.name: yellow
pickups.what: Yellow keycard: kept for the rest of the sector, opens every yellow door (Y).

pickups.name: health
pickups.what: Health pack: +25 health, up to 100; cures poison. Left lying if you're full and not poisoned.

pickups.name: ammo
pickups.what: Energy cells: +15, up to 99 carried. Left lying if you're full. Cells dropped or thrown out (loot, a monster's drop) become ammo for one of your energy guns (cells, rounds or slugs); cells placed on the map stay cells.

pickups.name: shells
pickups.what: Shells: +8, up to 40 carried. Left lying if you're full.

pickups.name: scatter
pickups.what: Scatter gun (gun 2) with 8 shells: 7 pellets in a spread, 1 damage each, a shot every 2/3 s. First one: you switch to it; again later it's just its shells.

pickups.name: repeater
pickups.what: Repeater (gun 3) with 60 rounds: automatic, about 12 shots a second, 1 damage each. Again later it's just its rounds.

pickups.name: armor
pickups.what: Armour: +50, up to 100. Armour takes a third of each hit until it runs out. Left lying if you're full.

pickups.name: medkit
pickups.what: Big medkit: +50 health, up to 100; cures poison. Left lying if you're full and not poisoned.

pickups.name: rail
pickups.what: Railgun (gun 4) with 6 slugs: 5 damage to every machine in its line up to the wall (sets off every barrel in it), a shot about every 0.9 s; right button zooms. Again later it's just its slugs.

pickups.name: map
pickups.what: The map: puts the minimap in the corner and shows the whole sector on the full map (Tab). Without it Tab shows only where you've been. One a sector.

pickups.name: overcharge
pickups.what: Overcharge: +100 health past full, up to 200 (the extra in blue on the health bar). Left lying at 200.

pickups.name: amp
pickups.what: Damage amp: every shot does double damage for 30 seconds.

pickups.name: core
pickups.what: Data core: only in the network (after jacking in) - grab the sector's cores against the clock to clear a data station. Not placeable on a map.

pickups.name: goggles
pickups.what: Night vision headset: yours till you die (as a gun is), on as you pick it up; NIGHT VISION (N) switches it. The world in green, the dark lifted. No battery. One you have already stays on the floor.

pickups.name: suit
pickups.what: Hazmat suit: poison, slime and acid wear the suit instead of you (about 45 s of poison, 20 of acid); fire and lava go straight through. Lost when you die. Left lying while yours is as good as new.

pickups.name: launcher
pickups.what: Rocket launcher (gun 5) with 5 rockets: a rocket bursts on what it hits - 6 on a direct hit plus a blast (up to 14, 2.4 cells across) that hurts you too up close (up to 30); right button zooms. Again later it's just its rockets.

pickups.name: rockets
pickups.what: Rockets: +5, up to 50 carried. Left lying if you're full.

pickups.name: rounds
pickups.what: Repeater rounds: +40, up to 200 carried. Left lying if you're full.

pickups.name: slugs
pickups.what: Railgun slugs: +5, up to 25 carried. Left lying if you're full.

pickups.name: jetpack
pickups.what: Jetpack: yours till you die, its tank full (100 - or its own [fuel] amount). Hold FLY / JET UP (E as made), or look up and walk, to fire it and rise; let go and you fall. A full tank is about 7 s of thrust. Another one tops your tank up.

pickups.name: jetfuel
pickups.what: Jet fuel can: +40 fuel (or its own [fuel] amount), tank holds 100. Only taken if you have a jetpack that isn't full.

pickups.name: repairkit
pickups.what: Computer repair kit: carry up to 3; Space on a broken computer with one fixes it (then it can be hacked).

pickups.name: invuln
pickups.what: Invulnerability: nothing hurts you for 5 seconds (a golden glow round the screen).

pickups.name: flashlight
pickups.what: Flashlight: yours till you die, battery full and on as you pick it up; FLASHLIGHT (L) switches it. Lights a cone where you look while its battery lasts (BATTERY LIFE, 5 minutes as made). A second one is a spare battery. Looks only - no machine notices it.

pickups.name: battery
pickups.what: Flashlight battery: a spare (up to 4); one goes in as the battery runs out - straight away if it's already dead.
